ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla Black Duct Tape, 1.88" x 35 yd, Black, (Bulk Pack of 18); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Eighteen rolls is more than I need for my occasional projects.
ItemID: NA; Title: 3" Swivel Caster Wheels with Safety Dual Locking and Polyurethane Foam No Noise Wheels, Heavy Duty - 250 Lbs Per Caster (Pack of 4); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my recent interest in movable furniture, but I already bought a caster set and have no clear need for another.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ginsco 580 pcs 2:1 Heat Shrink Tubing Kit 6 Colors 11 Sizes Assorted Sleeving Tube Wrap Cable Wire Kit for DIY; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to insulate connections on my relay and circuit-board projects; the assorted sizes look useful.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld 8277 WaterWeld Epoxy Putty Stick - 2 oz., Off White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a leak or wet-area repair that calls for this putty right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gorilla All Weather Outdoor Waterproof Duct Tape, UV and Temperature Resistant, 1.88" x 25 yd, Black, (Pack of 2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My outdoor surveillance stickers do not establish a current need for outdoor repair tape.
ItemID: NA; Title: Etekcity Digital Multimeter, Auto-Ranging Voltage Tester Volt Ohm Amp Meter with Continuity, Diode, Capacitance and Resistance Test, Blue, MSR-A600; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this for checking power supplies, wiring continuity, and components in my electronics projects.
ItemID: NA; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current metal-cutting project or established need for grinder accessories.
ItemID: NA; Title: Kreg SML-C125-500 Zinc Pocket-Hole Screws, 1 1/4 Inch #8 Coarse Thread, Maxi-Loc Head (500 Count); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying furniture casters does not mean I need pocket-hole screws, especially a box of 500.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would wait until I have a specific repair needing a permanent epoxy bond.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ginsco 360 Pcs Heat Shrink Tubing 3:1 Shrink Ratio Dual Wall Adhesive Lined Marine Grade Tube 6 Size: 3/8",1/4",3/16",1/8",3/32",1/16", 2 Color KIT Black Red; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Wire insulation suits my electronics work, but I would choose the assorted kit above this time; I have no specific need for adhesive-lined tubing.
